_about: How the battle pass' seasons look (GameLogic/Events/SeasonMarks.cpp). title: the line «Hero of Season N» over the name, text and background as [r, g, b, a] 0-255; topText and topBackground for the gold title of the season's Hall of Fame (its first ten accounts at the last level). aura: circle 'runes' (Effect/mzine_typer2) or 'none', circleColor as light [r, g, b] (1 = full), particles 'snow' (Effect/snowseff01/02, falling) or 'none', particleColor as light. A season missing here looks like the closest season before it. Stage 7 adds each season's Fenrir palette here.
